email.subject: DevOps Engineer application - Juniper Freight
email.body:
Hi,

Thanks for applying for the DevOps Engineer role at Juniper Freight and for speaking with me on the phone.

We've decided to move ahead with candidates who have more hands-on Kubernetes experience, so we won't be taking your application to the next stage.

If it helps, I'm happy to share more detailed feedback. Just reply to this email.

Regards,
Ravi Shah
Talent Partner
